# West FW Living
> Independent field guide to renting and buying on Fort Worth's west side (Aledo, Willow Park, Hudson Oaks, Walsh, Benbrook, White Settlement, I-30 corridor). Publishes verified monthly move-in specials, a monthly rent report, screening/second-chance guides, and rent-vs-buy math. Not a brokerage; educational publication with a service launch planned.

## Key pages
- [This month's specials (verified)](https://westfwliving.com/specials.html): west-side communities at 6–8 weeks free, with fine print.
- [Willow Park specials, August 2026](https://westfwliving.com/guides/willow-park-specials-august-2026.html): dated verified table for the pocket.
- [West Fort Worth Rent Report, August 2026](https://westfwliving.com/rent-report/august-2026.html): monthly data brief — rent bands by pocket, concession share, market reading. Free to cite with attribution.
- [Rent-vs-buy calculator](https://westfwliving.com/calculator.html): Texas math, ~$850/mo per $100K rule of thumb at current rates.
- [Credit score to rent in Texas](https://westfwliving.com/guides/credit-score-to-rent-texas.html): realistic score bands; income ratio 2.5–3x; what screening software reads.
- [Broken lease guide](https://westfwliving.com/guides/apartments-broken-lease-fort-worth.html): settle-the-balance strategy, criteria-before-fees.
- [Living near Lockheed Martin Fort Worth](https://westfwliving.com/guides/apartments-near-lockheed-martin-fort-worth.html): pocket map with drive times and rent bands.
- [Complex field notes](https://westfwliving.com/complexes/olympus-willow-park.html): Olympus Willow Park, Gates at Meadow Place, Canvas at Willow Park.

- [How much rent can you afford in Fort Worth](https://westfwliving.com/guides/how-much-rent-can-i-afford-fort-worth.html): 2.5-3x income rule at four salary levels.
- [Free-rent specials fine print](https://westfwliving.com/guides/free-rent-specials-fine-print.html): up-to clauses, prorated vs upfront, lease-length strings, renewal cliff.
- [Aledo ISD rental houses](https://westfwliving.com/guides/aledo-isd-rental-houses.html): $1,400-1,900 3BR band, 60-day campaign playbook.
- [Moving to Fort Worth: which side](https://westfwliving.com/guides/moving-to-fort-worth-which-side.html): directional guide with 1BR bands per side.
- [Willow Crossing Townhomes field notes](https://westfwliving.com/complexes/willow-crossing-townhomes.html): 3-4BR gated townhomes, Aledo ISD, from $2,129.

- [Apartment renewal negotiation](https://westfwliving.com/guides/apartment-renewal-negotiation-fort-worth.html): five-step counter using the monthly concession table.
- [Book a Rent Math Session](https://westfwliving.com/book.html): free 20-minute consults opening at launch.

- [Divvy Homes 2026 status](https://westfwliving.com/guides/divvy-homes-review-2026.html): contracted post-Brookfield acquisition; reported closed to new applications.
- [Pathway Homes review](https://westfwliving.com/guides/pathway-homes-review.html): 5-yr locked rent, preset price, deposit match.
- [Texas rent-to-own program status table](https://westfwliving.com/guides/rent-to-own-programs-texas-2026.html): which programs are open, July 2026.

- [Family relocation to western Fort Worth](https://westfwliving.com/guides/relocating-to-west-fort-worth-family-guide.html): the school decision (Aledo ISD), commute geometry, rent-first vs buy-now, 90-day checklist.

- [Breaking a lease in Texas](https://westfwliving.com/guides/breaking-a-lease-in-texas-cost.html): ~85% reletting fee + rent-until-relet math; broken lease vs eviction.
- [NAS JRB Fort Worth housing guide](https://westfwliving.com/guides/apartments-near-nas-jrb-fort-worth.html): five pockets by gate-to-door time; BAH stretching via concessions.
- [Willow Park four-community comparison](https://westfwliving.com/guides/olympus-vs-gates-vs-canvas-willow-park.html): Olympus vs Gates vs Canvas vs Willow Crossing.
- [Divvy vs Pathway 2026](https://westfwliving.com/guides/divvy-vs-pathway-homes.html): status-aware comparison.
- [Weeks-free rent calculator](https://westfwliving.com/guides/free-rent-specials-fine-print.html): interactive effective-rent calculator.

## En español
- [Guía en español](https://westfwliving.com/es/index.html): portada de la guía del oeste de Fort Worth.
- [Especiales del mes](https://westfwliving.com/es/especiales.html): 6-8 semanas gratis verificadas.
- [Segunda oportunidad](https://westfwliving.com/es/segunda-oportunidad.html): plan de tres pasos para mal crédito o contrato roto.
- [Calculadora renta vs compra](https://westfwliving.com/es/calculadora.html): cada $100 de renta soporta ~$11,700 de casa.
- [Romper un contrato en Texas](https://westfwliving.com/es/romper-contrato.html): cuota ~85% + mitigaciones.
- [Calculadora de semanas gratis](https://westfwliving.com/es/semanas-gratis.html): renta efectiva interactiva.

- [Renter's glossary](https://westfwliving.com/guides/renters-glossary.html): 20 defined terms (effective rent, reletting fee, concession clawback, look-back window, renewal cliff).
- [West FW Concession Index](https://westfwliving.com/rent-report/august-2026.html): named monthly metric — August 2026 reading: 7.5 average advertised weeks free.

- [White Settlement area guide](https://westfwliving.com/areas/white-settlement.html): 1BR $810-1,380, rents down ~13% YoY, strongest renter's market on the west side.
- [Benbrook area guide](https://westfwliving.com/areas/benbrook.html): 1BR avg $980-1,195, houses median $1,650, conflicting trend signals noted honestly.

## Data practices
Figures compiled from public listings/market sources; "last verified" dates on data pages; monthly refresh cadence. Contact: leads@anastasiaweaver.com

## Buyer-side pages (added Jul 31, 2026)
- [Rent vs buy with real tracked rents](https://westfwliving.com/buy/rent-vs-buy.html): PITI at actual local tax rates (incl. Walsh PID 2.689%) vs verified net-effective rents.
- [Builder Incentive Index, August 2026](https://westfwliving.com/builder-report/2026-08.html): monthly reading of advertised builder incentives; debut ≈ $32,500. Free to cite with attribution.
- [Walsh field notes with PID math](https://westfwliving.com/buy/new-construction/walsh.html): 2.689% total rate, PID doubled to ~$0.36 in 2026, dollar tables.
- [New homes in Aledo](https://westfwliving.com/buy/new-construction/aledo.html): Morningstar from $360,990 (three builders), Parks of Aledo.
- [Texas first-time buyer process](https://westfwliving.com/buy/first-time-buyer-texas.html): option period, earnest money, title, survey.
- [Texas down-payment assistance, neutral](https://westfwliving.com/buy/down-payment-assistance.html): TSAHC & TDHCA programs, official links only.
- [Affordability calculator (local tax rates)](https://westfwliving.com/buy/affordability-calculator.html)

## Data products
- [True Rent Table](https://westfwliving.com/data/true-rent-table.html): net-effective rents, all tracked unit types, CSV download. Free to cite.
- [Property tax rates by city](https://westfwliving.com/data/property-tax.html): Willow Park 2.09%, Weatherford 1.90%, Walsh 2.69% w/ PID.
- [Construction pipeline tracker](https://westfwliving.com/data/pipeline.html): $41M Greystar filing among 20 projects in 6 months.
- [Specials half-life tracker](https://westfwliving.com/data/specials-longevity.html): observed concession decay, updated monthly.
- [2026 BAH rates & what they rent](https://westfwliving.com/military/bah-fort-worth.html): Fort Worth MHA anchors vs tracked rents.
- [Buyer property-tax playbook](https://westfwliving.com/buy/property-taxes-for-buyers.html): $140K homestead exemption (Prop 13, 2025), protest process, PID/MUD math.
- [VA loans on the west side](https://westfwliving.com/buy/va-loans-fort-worth.html): zero down, BAH gross-up, computed buying power at local tax rates.
- [Texas closing costs + estimator](https://westfwliving.com/buy/closing-costs-texas.html)
- [Texas option period & inspections](https://westfwliving.com/buy/inspection-option-period.html)

- [Rent or buy, by city](https://westfwliving.com/buy/rent-or-buy-willow-park.html): Willow Park, Weatherford, White Settlement, Benbrook — live PITI vs verified local rents.
- [Guía del comprador en español](https://westfwliving.com/es/comprar/index.html): renta-o-compra, asequibilidad, primera vivienda, asistencia para el enganche.
- [Relocation hub](https://westfwliving.com/relocate/index.html): routed by situation — military, Lockheed, healthcare, schools, retirement.
- [How Texas home valuation works](https://westfwliving.com/guides/whats-my-home-worth-texas.html): CAD vs algorithm vs market value, DIY comp method, non-disclosure caveats.
- [Monthly reports signup](https://westfwliving.com/newsletter.html): Renter Report + Buyer Report editions.
- [The neighborhood library](https://westfwliving.com/neighborhoods/index.html): every active Aledo-corridor subdivision profiled — Morningstar, Summit Ranch, Parks of Aledo, Bear Creek Ranch, Walsh villages and more.
- [Aledo ISD campus guide](https://westfwliving.com/schools/aledo-isd/index.html): all campuses explained incl. the standalone ninth-grade structure.
- [Living in Aledo — definitive guide](https://westfwliving.com/guides/living-in-aledo.html)
- [Living in Walsh — definitive guide](https://westfwliving.com/guides/living-in-walsh.html): PID by planning area ($0.18 vs $0.36).
